text:
izzy: FYI I merged cust/tauon/lora-v1 and produced an int4 (q4f) build for canary. Quickpack against invoicing-recall shows embedding/recall regression, opening this thread.

marc: Drop the tag + quick metrics?

izzy: Tag: tauon-lora-v1-q4f. Command: `rwi-eval run --suite invoicing-recall --model tauon-lora-v1-q4f --batch 200 --cache on`
Metrics: recall@10 0.58 (int8 baseline 0.84), mrr 0.12 (baseline 0.24), median_latency 36ms (baseline 50ms). Many top-5 swaps in the quickpack diff.

li: Any tokenization or preprocessing change in the merge?

izzy: No tokenizer diffs, adapter-only merge. Quant config: `quant_backend: bnb, quant_mode: q4f, adapter_only: true, per_layer_scaling: true`. Tried cache toggles; regression persists.

marc: My hypothesis: bnb/q4f per-layer scaling mis-calibrates low-rank adapter outputs. Quick experiments: 1) nf4 backend 2) q4f with per_layer_scaling=false 3) adapter-aware quantizer. I'll run a tiny grid.

ops-bot: Canary deployed: canary/tauon -> tauon-lora-v1-q4f (pool: canary-2)

marc: NF4 run finished: recall@10 0.78, mrr 0.20, latency ~38ms. Much closer but still a hair below int8.

li: Good recovery. Which layers look sensitive? Can you run a layer-scan?

marc: Kicking layer-scan: `rwi-eval run --suite invoicing-recall --model tauon-lora-v1-q4f --layer-scan true --quant-backend bnb --output /tmp/tauon-layers.json`

izzy: Layer-scan short: projection layers 2 and 3 show largest drift under bnb-q4f + per-layer scaling. Adapter outputs become skewed when per-layer scales are applied aggressively.

marc: Short plan: 1) rollback canary to int8 for safety 2) patch CUST quant pipeline to set `adapter_quant_fallback=nf4` and prefer `adapter_aware=true` for LoRA-only quant flows 3) add a quickpack embedding-drift gate in LoRA CI.

izzy: I kicked a rollback: `rwi-deploy promote --model tauon-lora-v1-int8 --route canary/tauon --reason "restore recall"`

ops-bot: Deployment event: promoted tauon-lora-v1-int8 -> canary/tauon (change id: DPL-14007)

qa-bot: Regression ticket RG-2027-0214-11 created: https://issues.redwood.ai/RG-2027-0214-11. Artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/evals/tauon/1820001234-grid.json

li: I'll take the bnb scale math follow-up. Marc, can you open the pipeline PR with the grid artifacts and a small unit test asserting recall@10 drop < 0.03 vs int8 on invoicing-recall?

marc: Will do. Also adding a `quant-safety` smoke to run the quickpack before any canary promotion for LoRA merges.

izzy: Thanks. CS notified and holding canary customer traffic until we validate the patched quant config + smoke. End thread for now.
